privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How messages sent through the contact form on this site are handled.
privacy.intro: This notice explains what happens to your data when you use the contact form on this site. It is given under Article 13 of the GDPR.
privacy.contactGap: A contact email address for privacy questions has not been published yet.
privacy.contactGapLinkedin: A contact email address for privacy questions has not been published yet. Until it is, you can reach the controller on <link>LinkedIn</link>.
privacy.purpose: Your data is used only to read and reply to your enquiry.
privacy.basis: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR: the legitimate interest in answering people who get in touch.
privacy.voluntary: Giving your data is voluntary, but without it the form cannot be sent and you cannot get a reply.
privacy.stored: Your name, email address and message, the language of the page, and the time you sent the message.
privacy.notIp: Your IP address is not stored with the message. It is only held briefly in memory to limit repeated sending.
privacy.rights: You can ask for access to your data, and for it to be corrected, deleted or restricted. You can also object to its use. There is no automated decision-making or profiling.
privacy.complaint: You have the right to complain to the Polish data protection authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (<link>PUODO</link>).
privacy.cookies: This site sets no cookies for visitors and uses no analytics.
